funeral_masks.observation: The ruling dead are buried with hammered gold faces, so they meet the god as they looked in life.

elite_drinking_feasts.observation: The great houses keep feasting halls where drinking sets are shared among allies and retainers.

throne_room_protocol.observation: Every visitor to the throne room knows where to stand, when to bow and when to speak.

daily_life_tomb_painting.observation: Tomb walls show ploughing, fishing and feasting, so the dead keep their daily life beyond death.

guardian_beast_gateways.observation: Carved beasts flank the town gate and stare down every stranger who enters.

carved_ivory_panels.observation: Carvers cut ivory panels with hunts and battles for the furniture and caskets of the great.

chariot_race_games.observation: Chariots race around a turning post at the festival, and the whole town takes sides.

voyage_offerings.observation: Before a voyage the crew pours offerings to the god and vows a gift if they come home.

sketch_sherd_humor.observation: Workmen scratch jokes on sherds: a cat serving mice, an overseer asleep at his post.

cremation_urn_cemeteries.observation: The dead are burned and their ashes buried in urns, row upon row in shared fields.

lost_age_remembrance.observation: Singers lament the burned palaces and tell of the heroes who lived when kings were great.
lost_age_remembrance.ability_reason: The fallen palaces live on in lament and tale; what was lost is remembered, and the survivors hold together around it.

warrior_weapon_burials.observation: Iron swords are bent and buried with the warriors who carried them.

fixed_meter_epic_bards.observation: Bards recite thousands of lines in one fixed meter, with set phrases that carry the tale.

armed_youth_dances.observation: Young men dance in armour to the pipes, leaping and striking their shields in time.

hero_tomb_offerings.observation: Families bring offerings to the old tombs, believing the heroes of the lost age lie there.

geometric_funeral_vases.observation: Great vases painted with bands and mourners mark the graves of the rich families.

oracle_consultation.observation: At the shrine the god's chosen speaker answers questions of war, founding and law, and the answer is carried home.
oracle_consultation.ability_reason: Towns and rulers bring their hardest questions to the god's chosen speaker; a colony, a war or a law begins with the god's answer.
oracle_consultation.social_consequence: The shrine's answers weigh on every ruler, and its keepers grow rich on offerings

inscribed_dedications.observation: Letters cut on a bowl or a statue say who gave it to the god, and why.

shrine_festival_games.observation: Towns send athletes to games at the shared shrine, and a sacred truce protects them on the road even in war.
shrine_festival_games.ability_reason: Games at the shared shrine bring rival towns together under a sacred truce; travel and trade go on even in wartime.
shrine_festival_games.social_consequence: Victors come home as heroes, and towns spend lavishly to win

alphabetic_epitaphs.observation: Grave stones name the dead in letters: who they were, and who set up the stone.

civic_games.observation: Every town holds its own games under agreed rules, and its victors are honoured at home.

origin_order_poem.observation: A poem sets out the world's beginnings in order, every power in its place under the god.

written_epic.observation: The great epic is written down in letters, one fixed text for every teacher and reciter.
written_epic.ability_reason: The epic becomes one written text, taught to every child and quoted across the land; the shared story no longer drifts.

symposium_song_circles.observation: Guests on couches pass the cup and take turns singing verses of their own.

personal_lyric_poetry.observation: Poets sing of their own loves, fears and griefs, in their own voices.

lifesize_stone_statues.observation: Life-size stone youths stand at graves and in the god's house, one foot forward.

columned_stone_temple.observation: A stone house with columns on every side shelters the god's image, and the town builds its pride into it.
columned_stone_temple.ability_reason: The god's house becomes a columned stone temple; the town's wealth, skill and devotion are built into one lasting monument.
columned_stone_temple.social_consequence: Years of quarrying and hauling go into the god's house, and the town is proud of every drum of stone

animal_fables.observation: Fables of the fox, the crow and the lion carry a moral any child remembers.

initiation_mysteries.observation: Initiates are led through secret rites at night and promised a better lot after death.

civic_coin_emblems.observation: Each town stamps its own emblem, a beast, a plant or a wheel, on the coins it strikes.

choral_district_contests.observation: Each district trains a chorus of men and boys, and they compete at the festival for a bronze prize.

public_theatre.observation: The whole town sits on a hillside to watch actors and chorus perform the old stories.
public_theatre.ability_reason: Plays bring stories, criticism and public argument before the whole town; ideas spread through a shared audience.
public_theatre.social_consequence: The town argues over what it saw on stage, and the festival costs a rich man his year's surplus

narrative_figure_pottery.observation: Painted figures on vases tell the stories of gods and heroes, and the vases sell overseas.

tragic_drama_contests.observation: Poets compete with tragedies of old heroes whose pride brings ruin, and the town judges.

comparative_chronicles.observation: Historians travel, question witnesses and weigh rival accounts, and write down why wars began.
comparative_chronicles.ability_reason: History becomes inquiry: rival accounts are compared and causes argued, instead of one official memory repeated.

public_funeral_orations.observation: Each year a chosen speaker praises the town's war dead before their families.

satirical_comedy.observation: Comic poets mock generals, speakers and philosophers by name before the whole town.
satirical_comedy.social_consequence: The powerful are laughed at, and a little less feared

paid_wandering_teachers.observation: Travelling teachers charge fees to teach young men to argue either side of a case.
paid_wandering_teachers.social_consequence: Rich youths learn eloquence, and their elders complain that nothing is held sacred

proportion_canon_sculpture.observation: Sculptors follow a canon in which each part of the body is a fixed fraction of the whole.

public_ethical_dialogue.observation: A questioner stops men in the market and asks them what justice is, until their answers fall apart.
public_ethical_dialogue.social_consequence: Young men learn to question every custom, and their elders grow uneasy

painted_public_colonnades.observation: Long colonnades painted with battles and myths serve as the town's meeting place.

philosophy_school_communities.observation: Schools of philosophy hold their own grounds and heads, and teaching passes from each head to the next.
philosophy_school_communities.ability_reason: Schools of philosophy become lasting communities; teaching and argument pass unbroken from generation to generation.
philosophy_school_communities.social_consequence: Rival schools draw the ablest young men away from public life and from the god's rites

stone_theatre_building.observation: Stone seats rise in a great half-bowl, and ten thousand hear an actor's whisper.

character_portrait_writing.observation: Writers sketch human types, the flatterer, the miser, the boor, in short, sharp portraits.

portrait_likeness_sculpture.observation: Sculptors carve rulers and thinkers as they truly look, wrinkles and all.

public_libraries.observation: Great collections of books are opened to readers from beyond the court, who copy and argue over them.
public_libraries.ability_reason: Great collections are open to scholars beyond the court; readers across the land compare, copy and teach from the same books.

figured_floor_mosaics.observation: Floors of small set stones show hunts, sea creatures and scenes from the plays.

consolation_philosophies.observation: Teachers counsel calm: what cannot be controlled should not be feared.

colossal_city_statue.observation: A bronze giant of the town's patron stands over the harbour, cast in sections over twelve years.
colossal_city_statue.social_consequence: Twelve years of bronze and labor stand in the harbour

pastoral_poetry.observation: Poets sing of shepherds, flocks and love in a gentle, idealized countryside.

translated_foreign_drama.observation: Foreign plays and epics are translated into the home tongue and staged at the festivals.

learned_allusive_poetry.observation: Court poets write short, learned verse full of rare myths that only scholars catch.

funeral_combat_spectacles.observation: At great funerals, pairs of armed men fight in honour of the dead.

ancestor_wax_masks.observation: Wax masks of ancestors who held office hang in the hall, and walk again at family funerals.

emotional_realism_sculpture.observation: Sculptors carve agony and struggle: a dying warrior, a drunken old woman, a boxer resting.

victory_triumph_procession.observation: The victorious general parades his army, spoils and captives through the town to the god's house.

verse_satire.observation: Poets mock the vices of the day in verse: greed, pretension and the hunting of legacies.

leisure_gardens.observation: Schools and wealthy men keep gardens with shaded walks for study and talk.

illusion_wall_painting.observation: Painted columns and windows open imaginary vistas on the walls of the great houses.

founding_era_annals.observation: Years are counted from the town's founding, and every event is set in one unbroken reckoning.

public_bath_sociability.observation: Men of every rank meet at the baths to wash, exercise, talk business and trade gossip.
public_bath_sociability.social_consequence: The baths bring every rank together, and every rank's ailments with them

love_elegy.observation: Poets write elegies to a single beloved, and a book of them makes a name.

commissioned_founding_epic.observation: The ruler's poet sings the town's founding by the god's will, and every schoolboy learns the new epic.
commissioned_founding_epic.ability_reason: A commissioned epic ties the ruling house to the town's founding under the god; every school teaches it.
commissioned_founding_epic.social_consequence: The epic makes the ruler's house the goal of all history

pantomime_dance_theatre.observation: A single masked dancer mimes every role of a myth to music, and the crowds adore him.

crossroads_shrine_clubs.observation: Neighbours form clubs to keep the crossroads shrine, hold its feast and elect its officers.

circus_race_factions.observation: Four racing teams in four colours command fierce loyalties, and their supporters brawl in the streets.
circus_race_factions.social_consequence: The races bind the town to its ruler and split it into rival colours

amphitheatre_spectacles.observation: In the amphitheatre, beasts brought from distant lands are hunted before the crowd.
amphitheatre_spectacles.social_consequence: The crowd is fed spectacle, and whole regions are stripped of their great beasts

triumphal_arch.observation: A stone arch carved with the victory spans the road the army marched in on.

published_letter_collections.observation: A statesman's letters are collected and published, and read as models of style.

prose_romance_novel.observation: Long prose tales of parted lovers, pirates and shipwrecks are read aloud in households.

painted_panel_portraits.observation: A painted wooden panel of the dead person's face is bound over the wrapped body.

paired_lives_biography.observation: Lives of great men are written in pairs, one from each of two peoples, and compared.

narrative_victory_column.observation: A carved band winds up a tall column, telling a whole campaign scene by scene.

monument_travel_guides.observation: Guidebooks lead travellers from shrine to shrine, describing each monument and its story.

display_oratory.observation: Famous speakers give display orations to packed halls, and are paid like champion athletes.

carved_sarcophagi.observation: Stone coffins carved with myths of death and return hold the wealthy dead.

glass_wall_mosaics.observation: Walls and vaults glitter with glass cubes, gold sealed behind glass catching the lamplight.

contemplative_ascent_schools.observation: Schools teach that the soul rises by contemplation toward union with the god.
contemplative_ascent_schools.social_consequence: Inquiry turns inward, away from the measurable world

underground_burial_galleries.observation: Burial clubs dig long galleries under the town where members lie side by side in niches.

holy_servant_lives.observation: Lives of the god's devoted servants are written as models and read aloud on their feast days.

congregational_hymns.observation: The whole congregation sings hymns together in the god's house, not the choir alone.

honored_ascetics.observation: Solitary men who live on bread and water in the wilderness are sought out as close to the god.
honored_ascetics.social_consequence: Some of the able leave fields and families for solitude

weekly_rest_day.observation: Every seventh day work stops for the god, and markets, courts and workshops close.
weekly_rest_day.social_consequence: One day in seven the fields and workshops stand idle, and the people are the better rested for it

canonized_sacred_sayings.observation: The god's sayings are gathered and fixed in one book, and every other version is set aside.
canonized_sacred_sayings.ability_reason: The god's sayings are fixed in one book; every congregation reads the same words, and disputes are settled by the text.
canonized_sacred_sayings.social_consequence: A fixed canon unites the faithful and brands every other text as false

congregation_hall_temples.observation: Long timber-roofed halls hold the whole congregation when it gathers for the god's rites.
congregation_hall_temples.ability_reason: The whole congregation gathers under one roof for the god's rites; the faithful meet every week as one body.
congregation_hall_temples.social_consequence: Every town must raise a great hall, and the roof beams come from ever farther forests

illuminated_codices.observation: Books are painted with pictures of the story, framed on the page beside the text.
